- **Managed runtimes** — install, switch, delete, and verify multiple DSH"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" versions side by side; each instance is pinned to its own version.
- **Multi-instance isolation** —"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" every instance gets its own `$DSH_HOME`; plugins and configuration never bleed between instances. C"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"reate, rename, clone, delete, switch.
- **Model providers** — API keys live in Windows Credential Ma"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"nager and never touch disk in plaintext; a built-in provider library plus model catalog sync.
- **Pl"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ugin marketplace** — five catalogs (plugins / skins / skills / MCP / bundles); registry browsing, sm"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"art (LLM-reranked) search, and install / uninstall / hot enable-disable through the `cordis.patch.ym"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"l` layer, which survives reconciliation by `dsh plugin`.

- **Embedded DSH window** — DSH renders inside the launcher's own window rat"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"her than a browser tab; closing the window stops the harness.
